result_text:
I changed the standard conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add tests for the new patterns, so they haven't been exercised directly. `mvn -o test -Dtest='*Scop*'` passed, but I didn't check which test classes that pattern matched.

- **Hidden files rule:** I replaced the "Hidden files and folders" rule with an ignore rule for version-control metadata. It matches `(.*/)?[.](git|svn|hg|bzr)/.*`, so it covers `.git`, `.svn`, `.hg` and `.bzr` at any depth, including a path that starts directly with `.git/`. Plain dotfiles and other dotted folders are no longer ignored.
- **IDE and build-tool folders:** I added a build-and-deployment rule with `(.*/)?[.](idea|vscode|vs|gradle|mvn|settings|metadata|circleci)/.*`. The contents of those folders go into the build-and-deployment scope instead of being ignored.
- **`dependencies` folders:** I removed the `.*/dependencies/.*` ignore rule.

I left the other ignore rules alone, including `.yarn/releases`, `.yarn/plugins`, `node_modules` and `vendor`.

I assumed ignore rules take precedence over the other scopes, so I didn't check how the scoping code orders them.
